title: Constitution Day Protest Highlights: Congress, SP hold nationwide protests against CEC on Constitution Day

ai.summary: Congress and SP held nationwide protests on Constitution Day against the Election Commission, with farmers joining the anti-SIR protest in Delhi and youth organizing 'Run for Constitution' marathons in Rajasthan.

facts.claim: Congress and SP held nationwide protests on Constitution Day against the Election Commission
facts.quote: Constitution Day Protest Highlights: Congress, SP hold nationwide protests against CEC on Constitution Day

facts.claim: Farmers joined the anti-SIR protest in Delhi
facts.quote: Farmers under the banner of the Samyukta Kisan Morcha (SKM) and KKU joined the 'People Against SIR' protest in Delhi on Thursday

facts.claim: Youth organized 'Run for Constitution' marathons in Rajasthan
facts.quote: The Rajasthan unit of the National Students' Union of India (NSUI) organised a 'Run for Constitution' marathon at the main gate of Rajasthan University on Thursday

ai.background_note: Congress and SP organized nationwide protests on Constitution Day targeting the Election Commission, with farmers joining the anti-SIR protest in Delhi and youth organizing marathons in Rajasthan.
